label: Typing indicator
purpose: Signal that the assistant is composing, as presence rather than noise.
when_to_use: A lightweight 'the assistant is about to speak' cue when there is no named step and no tokens yet.
when_not_to_use: When a step can be named (use ThinkingIndicator) or when tokens are streaming (use StreamingText).
composition: Three grayscale dots on the spacing scale, pulsing on a stagger
accessibility: role=status with an aria-label describing the meaning of the dots
dots are aria-hidden; the label carries the meaning
animation collapses to a static row under prefers-reduced-motion
anti_patterns: colouring the dots — a coloured indicator reads as state
using it in place of a named step when one is available
assumptions: Atomic ai-component: composed from tokens + the spacing scale, no shadcn primitive exists for it.
Mount/unmount is driven by the caller to reflect the real composing window.

references.note: assistant-ui's Elements catalogue (https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements, checked 2026-08) is the CONCEPTUAL reference; no code is copied. This is an atomic element with no shadcn primitive — it is built from DLS tokens and the spacing scale only, which is why composes.components is empty.
